title: Track calls from your website with a number pool
blurb: Show different numbers to visitors so you know which ad made the phone ring.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Phone System
steps.body: Click **Phone System** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Create a pool
steps.tip: See **Your phone system requires configuration**? We need to switch Luubu Phone on for you. Email hello@luubu.com.

steps.title: Set it up
steps.body: Name the pool and choose how many numbers (at least 4). Each number has its own monthly cost.

steps.title: Where calls go
steps.body: Enter your forwarding number: your mobile or office line, not a Luubu Phone number, or calls will loop.

steps.title: Number to swap
steps.body: Enter the number shown on your website now. Luubu swaps it for a pool number for each visitor.

steps.title: Add the code to your site
steps.body: Copy the tracking code from the pool info and paste it into your website's body tracking code.

steps.title: Test it
steps.body: Visit your site in a private browser window from an ad or link and check the number changes.
